name: andrew designs
author: Andrew Tang
description: Andrew Tang is a product designer at the intersection of design and data, using AI to prototype quickly and designing human-in-the-loop AI workflows.
intro: Hi, I’m Andrew and I work at the **intersection of design + data**, currently designing human-in-the-loop AI workflows to explore data, discover trends, and enable data-driven decisions. I’ve agentified my process to go quickly from idea to working prototype, testing assumptions early and shortening iteration cycles.
